Compression Modes — zfp 0.5.4 documentation
Compression Modes ¶ zfp accepts one or more parameters for specifying how the data is to be compressed to meet various constraints on accuracy or size. At a high level, there are four different compression modes that are mutually exclusive: expert, fixed-rate, fixed-precision, and fixed-accuracy mode.
